title: The Devil Never Cries
description: Altair, the warrior king of humanity, is resurrected after being killed by a powerful monster, only to find himself sixty years in the future with a completely new body. Starting from scratch, Altair must learn how to survive in this strange new world, facing countless mysterious and terrifying unknowns, while simultaneously evolving his originally fragile body to become a powerful force to save humanity from the ravages of demons.
